title: Hooker Valley Track: Aoraki/Mount Cook National Park, Canterbury region
overview: Walk through the Hooker Valley to the foot of Aoraki/Mount Cook on one of New Zealand’s best day walks.
No dogs. Other pets on conservation land rules.
lines: Department of Conservation Te Papa Atawhai
Department of Conservation | Te Papa Atawhai
After the second swing bridge, the valley floor widens and tussocks are the dominant plant. Toilets are available 15 min after the second swing bridge.
The track to Mueller Hut starts near the White Horse Hill car park. DOC charges fees for car parking at White Horse Hill.
The fees are $2.50 per half hour or $25 a day. If you arrive and leave within 20 minutes, parking is free. If you plan to stay for longer than 20 minutes you must pay on arrival.

Note: If you arrive one day and leave the next you will pay car parking fees for two days ($50). If you plan to stay for multiple days ($50 or more) it may be more affordable for you to purchase an annual permit.
How to pay fees or buy an annual permit .
The track is designed to avoid the risk of avalanche – keep to the tracks.
